dataset.name: HAPT (UCI ML Repository id 341) — real smartphone acc+gyro @50Hz
dataset.normalisation: per-channel mean/std from TRAIN subjects' streams only
dataset.sequencing: 512-step windows, stride 256, per (experiment,user) stream; windows touching unlabelled samples dropped; boundary/transition windows always kept, pure windows capped at <=30% of each split
dataset.y6_mapping: transition classes 7-12 mapped to TARGET activity (stand-to-sit->sitting, sit-to-stand->standing, sit-to-lie->laying, lie-to-sit->sitting, stand-to-lie->laying, lie-to-stand->standing); y_trans marks timesteps whose original label was a transition class

protocol: Subject-disjoint train(21)/val(4)/test(5). Model selection on val macro F1 only. Test evaluated exactly once per candidate, after selection. Every experiment logged, including failures.

reference_windowed_hapt.protocol_note: Windowed classification (128-sample windows, one label per window), subject-disjoint split from the same research line. NOT directly comparable: windowed scoring never has to label transition timesteps densely, and the split/labels differ.

synthetic_reference.note: Synthetic-data numbers from results.json — pipeline proof only, superseded as headline by the real-data results below.

experiments.name: harth_p2_aug_c12_refine_bh10
experiments.CORRECTION_2026_11_10: The val/val_boundary_refined metrics in this entry are INVALID: model_probs aggregated the 12 HARTH outputs through HAPT MAP12_TO_6 and macro-F1 used C=6. Training itself was correct (true 12-class loss). Corrected true-12-class evaluation of the saved checkpoints is in results_harth.json (val: acc 0.9508 / F1 0.7124 raw; bref+mindur25 seg25 0.8504; test confirmation #1: F1 0.7131, seg25 0.7537). Trainer fixed via SINGLE_LABEL_12 for non-HAPT datasets.

config.pipeline: causal model (full-past context, zero lookahead) -> segment_majority(0.5) -> min_duration_left(theta=10)
config.causality: model provably causal (test_causal.py perturbation test, zero leakage); segment_majority finalises a segment at its next cut and min_duration_left merges left-only, so emission is delayed to segment close; raw row is the pure zero-delay readout

boundary_delay_test.note: emitted switch position minus GT boundary, tol +-25 steps; excludes the segment-close emission delay of the refinement

config.lookahead_seconds: 1.28..1.58 (64 + up to 15 tile steps @ 50 Hz; mean ~1.43 s)
config.pipeline: offline champion read semi-online: tiled windows (16-step blocks, right edge 64 steps past block end) -> segment_majority(0.5) -> min_duration_left(theta=10)
config.causality: model is offline (uses future context within the window); streaming-equivalence is by construction: each label reads at most 64..79 future steps. Post-processing finalises a segment at its next cut and merges left-only, so emission is delayed to segment close; raw row is the un-post-processed tiled readout

final.selection_rule: highest val macro F1 among phase-2 final candidates (val F1 0.9675); system = physics augmentation + 12-class supervision + 3-seed probability ensemble + val-tuned post-processing pack
